goal: Produce a reproducible capacity analysis using the Phase 8 Universal Value Work Lab.
inputText: Use the locally served workbench at http://127.0.0.1:18798/workbench/. Inspect the balanced launch scenario, then the review bottleneck and worker interruption. Return the exact exported balanced phase8-capacity-plan.json as capacity-plan.json and evidence.md describing the actual actions, results, runtime versions and errors. Do not fabricate execution or acceptance. No public posting, purchase, signing, payment or external transmission is authorized. A separate reviewer must recalculate the results.
acceptanceCriteria: Balanced plan admits 54 and expects 43 accepted jobs with 29700 USDC reserved and 24200 USDC spent.
Review bottleneck admits 8 and expects 6 accepted; worker interruption admits 16 and expects 12 accepted.
evidence.md records actual actions and discloses blockers; no independent acceptance or paid settlement is claimed.
